name: Dual Grid Traversal for Adaptive Octree
definition: A recursive algorithm to traverse an adaptive octree and generate dual grid cells (vertices, edges, faces) by visiting nodes at varying levels of detail. It handles cases where adjacent nodes have different depths by using parent nodes as stand-ins for missing children.
summary: Dual Grid Traversal for Adaptive Octree recursively generates a manifold mesh from non-uniform voxel data by using surrounding octree nodes to bridge gaps between different refinement levels.
